title: The Telangana Reservation of seats in the Educational Institutions and of appointments or posts in the Public Services under the State to Muslim Community Act, 2005.
full_text: The Telangana Reservation of seats in the Educational Institutions and of appointments or posts in the Public Services under the State to Muslim Community Act, 2005. Long Title: An Act to provide Reservation to Muslim Community in the matters of admission into Educational Institutions and Appointments to Public Services in the State of Telangana and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
